items.headline: FAA Orders Rare Nationwide Ground Stop Following U.S. Air Traffic System Outage
items.summary: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration issued a nationwide ground stop on Friday after a critical telecommunications outage impacted air traffic control centers across the country. The sudden system failure disrupted over 11,000 flights and stranded thousands of travelers, though officials reported no evidence of a cyberattack.

items.headline: Widespread Microsoft Outage Disrupts Business and Cloud Services Globally
items.summary: A major technical issue at Microsoft caused a global outage that disrupted email, communication tools, and enterprise services for millions of users across dozens of countries. Microsoft confirmed it has addressed the core problem and ruled out a cyberattack as recovery efforts continue.

items.headline: Rory McIlroy Shares Lead at Season-Ending DP World Tour Championship
items.summary: Rory McIlroy shot a second-round 70 at Jumeirah Golf Estates in Dubai to share the 36-hole lead at 5-under par alongside Tyrrell Hatton. The strong halfway finish keeps the Northern Irishman on track for both the tournament victory and a record-equalling eighth Race to Dubai crown.

items.headline: Rosalía Makes History with Third Album of the Year Win at the Latin Grammys
items.summary: At the 27th Annual Latin Grammy Awards in Las Vegas, Spanish singer Rosalía won Album of the Year for her project LUX, along with Song of the Year for La Perla. The victory makes her the first female artist in Latin Grammy history to claim Album of the Year three times.
